step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture describes Predict HQ's demand intelligence platform on AWS. Fetcher ASG fetches ~7TB of raw data daily from external Data Sources and stores it in Data Stores (Kafka and Elasticsearch on EC2/RDS). Pipeline ASG pulls raw data from Data Stores, performs NLP and machine learning deduplication, and aggressively caches processed records into DynamoDB (using TTL to manage ~90M records) and Redis Cache. Customer ASG serves end customers via the Control Center web app, developer APIs (~25k req/min), AWS Data Exchange, and Snowflake.
